verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair question for a SaaS email product like Shortwave, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows no public API reference or runnable examples. The OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404, and the docs cover only user how-tos, shortcuts and search operators. MCP client integrations let Shortwave consume other apps; they are not an API reference for Shortwave itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
